title: Kit manifest
description: v0.1 (#498, D-032). The file kit.json in an exported kit folder <output dir>/Samples/Kits/<folder>/: which copied sample sits in which slot. Files only; nothing in it is sent to Ableton. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (file naming, sidecar copies, no overwrite, what a failed export leaves) are part of this contract: docs/INTERFACES.md 'Kit manifest'.

name.description: Kit name as the user gave it, made file-system safe (ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'; at most 80 characters). The folder is this name, or this name with _002, _003 ... when a kit of that name already exists.

created_at.description: When the kit was exported. RFC 3339 with upper-case T and an explicit offset; the GUI writes UTC with Z.

slots.description: One entry per slot. The six drum slots are required; bass is optional (left out when empty, never null).

file.description: File name of the copy inside the kit folder: two-digit slot number, '_', slot tag, '_', the source stem (e.g. 01_kick_kick-rumble.wav). Its sidecar is the same name with .json.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the copy's bytes (equal to the source's bytes at export), lower-case hex.

source.description: Path of the source WAV relative to the output dir at export time, same rules as the choice log's sample.path. Informative only: sha256 is the identity.

category.description: The source sidecar's category, copied as is; each slot allows only its own categories.
